title: Canonical valid GetNameList over framed MMS transport
purpose: Provide a compact framed confirmed request using documented MMS Confirmed-Request-PDU and confirmed service tag [1] GetNameList with consistent TPKT and BER nesting.
expected_behavior: A receiver should accept TPKT and COTP CR framing, parse an AARQ-like ACSE wrapper, reach user-information, and then dispatch the embedded MMS Confirmed-Request-PDU to the GetNameList service path.
constraints_preserved: TPKT version is 0x03 and total length 0x0027 matches 39 bytes.
COTP CR length byte 0x11 matches the 17 bytes following it before ACSE content.
ACSE message type uses documented 0x60 AARQ.
ACSE context identifier is encoded as 02 01 01.
User-information tag 0xbe uses definite BER length.
Embedded MMS PDU tag is 0xa0 and confirmed service tag is [1] encoded as 0xa1.
All BER and transport lengths are self-consistent.
issue_safety_notes: This does not reproduce any known crash payload and avoids malformed or oversized lengths. It is a conservative framed request seed.
